info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Balances-v3-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Balance API enables users to access up-to-date balance information for their banking accounts. This endpoint retrieves balance data, essential for consumers managing personal and business finances. Typical use cases include integrations with financial applications, personal finance management tools, and accounting software. Developers can leverage this API to enhance user experience by providing real-time balance visibility for informed financial decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve the current balance of the account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to get the current balance for a specified account. Make sure to provide the necessary authentication and account identifiers to access the balance information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the balance for a specific account. Ensure that the necessary authentication and account information is provided to execute the balance retrieval successfully.

ListBankingAccountsBalancesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the GET balance operations on accounts. It is a simple string type, which may be used for various purposes related to account balance queries.
